load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint restoring model, optimizer, logger, and scheduler state
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with model, optimizer, logger, and scheduler state to disk
load_path: load a PyTorch checkpoint file from disk mapping GPU tensors to CPU
load_with_fallback: load a checkpoint with automatic fallback to backup .bak file on failure
save_with_backup: save a checkpoint creating a backup copy and periodic numbered snapshots
